# GASLY Skills — AI Agent Index

> Indonesian-language modular skill pack for planning, designing, implementing, and deploying full-stack web applications with Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Google Drive, and external frontend stacks.

## Canonical Skills
- [gasly-start](dist/modular/gasly-start/SKILL.md): workflow router and stage detection; does not imply automatic cross-skill orchestration.
- [gasly-prd](dist/modular/gasly-prd/SKILL.md): product discovery, PRD, implementation prompt, and machine-readable GASLY contract.
- [gasly-prd-to-uiux](dist/modular/gasly-prd-to-uiux/SKILL.md): PRD-to-UIUX, Image-First Visual Analysis, and combined design prompt/handoff.
- [gasly-pro-api](dist/modular/gasly-pro-api/SKILL.md): full-stack implementation coordinator.
- [gasly-data](dist/modular/gasly-data/SKILL.md): headless GAS API, authentication, Sheets, Drive, and available integrations.
- [gasly-ui](dist/modular/gasly-ui/SKILL.md): decoupled frontend, stack adapters, design tokens, and responsive UI.
- [gasly-deploy-guide](dist/modular/gasly-deploy-guide/SKILL.md): interactive standalone deployment/setup guide.
- [gasly-pro](dist/modular/gasly-pro/SKILL.md): legacy HtmlService monolithic application builder.

## Compatibility Aliases
- `gasly-prompt` → `gasly-prd`.
- `gasly-install` → `gasly-deploy-guide`.
